title: Tensor train compression and truncation error

items.title: Finite tensor arrays and the Frobenius inner product
items.statement: Finite arrays over R or C, their Frobenius inner product and norm, and fixed mode/cut unfolding conventions.

items.title: Tensor unfoldings preserve the Frobenius inner product
items.statement: Every fixed mode or cut unfolding is a reindexing bijection and preserves Frobenius inner products and norms.

items.title: Tucker format, multilinear rank, and mode products
items.statement: Mode-k matricization rank, mode-k matrix multiplication, Tucker cores, and rank-bounded orthogonal projection models.

items.title: Tensor train cores, bond ranks, and canonical gauges
items.statement: TT core contraction, bond ranks, gauge transformations, and left/right isometric core conventions.

items.title: Canonical polyadic rank
items.statement: CP rank is the least number of elementary tensor products whose sum is the tensor.

items.title: Best rank-k matrix approximation in Frobenius norm
items.statement: The rank-k truncated SVD minimizes Frobenius error among matrices of rank at most k, with error the square root of the discarded squared singular values.

items.title: Full-column-rank matrix least squares has a unique minimizer
items.statement: For a full-column-rank design matrix, the Frobenius least-squares problem has one minimizer, given by the normal equations.

items.title: Sequential tensor-train SVD
items.statement: Left-to-right unfolding and exact SVD steps with explicit rank-cap or per-cut absolute tail-tolerance selection and zero-rank conventions.

items.title: Tensor-train rounding
items.statement: Lossless left orthogonalization followed by a right-to-left core SVD sweep with explicit rank-cap or per-cut tail-tolerance selection and zero-rank conventions.

items.title: Tensor-train storage and inner-product costs
items.statement: TT storage equals the sum of core sizes, and a contraction algorithm computes the inner product of two TT tensors with a mode-size/rank-explicit arithmetic bound.

items.title: Higher-order SVD truncation
items.statement: Mode-wise SVD projection onto the leading left singular subspaces with explicit multilinear rank caps and zero-rank conventions.

items.title: Budgeted CP alternating least squares
items.statement: Finite-sweep block least-squares procedure, using exact block minimizers and an explicit rank-deficient design-matrix status branch.

items.title: Exact TT ranks and root-sum-square truncation error
items.statement: Full-rank TT-SVD gives an exact minimal-bond-rank representation; TT-SVD and canonical-gauge rounding have Frobenius error at most the root sum of squared discarded singular-value tails.

items.title: HOSVD quasioptimality for multilinear rank
items.statement: The truncated HOSVD error is at most sqrt(d) times the infimal Frobenius error over tensors with the prescribed multilinear-rank bounds.

items.title: Exact CP-ALS block updates do not increase the objective
items.statement: Each successful exact block least-squares update does not increase the Frobenius residual; a rank-deficient halt leaves the objective unchanged.

title: Tensor train compression and truncation error — Examples

items.title: A best rank-two CP approximation need not exist
items.statement: A real 2x2x2 tensor of CP rank three is a Frobenius limit of tensors of CP rank at most two, so its best rank-two CP approximation is not attained.

items.title: A separable grid tensor has TT rank one
items.statement: A nonzero outer product of mode vectors has rank-one cut unfoldings and an exact rank-one TT representation.

items.title: Two TT truncations realize the root-sum-square bound
items.statement: A 2x2x2 tensor has discarded tails 2 and 1 in its two TT-SVD steps and resulting Frobenius error sqrt(5).

items.title: A diagonal tensor has large minimal TT ranks
items.statement: For d at least three, the sum of n matching basis tensors has cut unfoldings of rank n and hence minimal TT bond ranks n.
